name: go-selectable
description: Offered in the goal-setup model picker. Says where a model is OFFERED, not who may run it -- an untagged model stays active and assignable everywhere else.

name: reasoning
description: Model supports extended/deliberate reasoning mode. Wire-meaningful: sets contract field reasoning=true.

name: vision
description: Model accepts image input. Wire-meaningful: adds "image" to contract field input (text is always included).
